PM.description: P-M Interaction Curve (PM). Computes the design axial-moment (Phi*Pn, Phi*Mn) interaction data per element from the analysis and RC design results; the request body carries only an optional output file path.

Argument.description: Optional absolute file path to export the computed PM interaction result as a JSON file. If empty, no file is exported and the result is only returned in the response.
